reference.description: Locally verified GOG base-game game.exe. Addresses are valid only for this digest.

original_executable.limit: 594 bounded scenarios, not whole-game or pixel parity.

fixture_corrections: Two fixtures shared hard-coded ENet ports with other programs; use an OS-assigned port and connect to host.host_port. Spell requirements and dialogue highlights pass after correction.

Pickup tracing proved the first race observed the previous scripted corpse notice arriving 46 ms after the observer arrays were cleared. Wait for that actual prior event before the race; do not ignore duplicate notices. Corrected test passes 42 assertions.
The initial rendered worker/transition timing checks ran alongside CPU-heavy programs. Preserve those failures and the subsequent quiet reruns separately.

Initial packaged mod-effects invocation omitted --package, initial Arena EN/DE invocations used --lang instead of --text-ui, and initial FSR render test still read the removed launcher capability. Retain original attempts; corrected invocations/tests are the qualification evidence.

fsr.validated: FSR 3.1 upscaling and frame generation on RTX 3090, Wine 9 and VKD3D 3.0.1; active XP formula in the same campaign process

other_validation.wiki: Article export remains 1.10.0; frontend version 1.20.0. Existing creature/map UI and six localized catalogs verified.

limits: OpenGL campaign footprints remain failing in three fixtures (issue #29).
Native macOS and Android execution not performed for this release; macOS package unsigned.
Behavioral regression assertions do not establish full parity with the original game.
Other open issues, including partial UI changes and unreproduced timing/performance cases, are not claimed resolved.
publication: Prepared for public v1.20.0 release. Publication and deployment receipts are recorded separately after upload.
